guides.title: Create Your FyndRx Account
guides.summary: Set up a free account to unlock ordering, prescriptions, and consultations.

steps.title: Tap "Create Account"
steps.description: Start from the homepage or the app menu.

steps.title: Enter your details
steps.description: Provide your full name, phone number, and email address.

steps.title: Verify your phone number
steps.description: Enter the OTP code sent to you by SMS.

steps.title: Set a password
steps.description: Choose a secure password to finish setting up your account.

guides.tip: You can browse medications and pharmacies without an account — but you'll need one to order, upload prescriptions, or book a consultation.

guides.title: Complete Your Health Profile
guides.summary: Add key health details so pharmacists and doctors can serve you safely and quickly.

steps.title: Open your profile
steps.description: Go to Profile, then Edit Profile.

steps.title: Add personal details
steps.description: Fill in your date of birth, gender, and delivery address.

steps.title: List allergies or conditions
steps.description: Optional, but recommended so prescriptions can be checked for safety.

steps.title: Save changes
steps.description: Your profile is now ready for faster checkouts and consultations.

guides.tip: A complete profile speeds up prescription verification and consultation bookings.

guides.title: Understand Your Dashboard
guides.summary: Your dashboard is the control center for every order, prescription, and appointment.

steps.title: Log in
steps.description: Open your Dashboard from the main menu after signing in.

steps.title: Explore quick links
steps.description: Jump straight to Orders, Prescriptions, Consultations, and Favorites.

steps.title: Check notifications
steps.description: The bell icon shows order and appointment updates as they happen.

guides.tip: Pin FyndRx to your home screen for one-tap access to your dashboard.

guides.title: Search for a Medication
guides.summary: Find exactly what you need from thousands of listed medications.

steps.title: Open the search bar
steps.description: Use the homepage search or go to "Browse Medications".

steps.title: Type a name or condition
steps.description: Search by medication name, brand, or the condition it treats.

steps.title: Filter your results
steps.description: Narrow down by dosage form, category, or availability.

guides.tip: Can't find an exact match? Try the generic name — many brands share the same active ingredient.

guides.title: Compare Prices Across Pharmacies
guides.summary: See every partner pharmacy's price side by side before you buy.

steps.title: Open a medication page
steps.description: Tap any medication from your search results.

steps.title: View the price list
steps.description: See prices from every partner pharmacy that stocks it.

steps.title: Sort your options
steps.description: Order results by lowest price or nearest distance.

steps.title: Pick the best fit
steps.description: Choose the pharmacy that offers the best value for you.

guides.tip: Prices can vary significantly between pharmacies in the same city — always compare before you order.

guides.title: Find a Pharmacy Near You
guides.summary: Discover verified pharmacies close to you, with hours, services, and stock.

steps.title: Open Pharmacies
steps.description: Select "Pharmacies" from the main menu.

steps.title: Share your location
steps.description: Allow location access, or enter your area manually.

steps.title: Browse the list
steps.description: See verified pharmacies sorted by distance, rating, and services.

steps.title: View pharmacy details
steps.description: Tap a pharmacy to see its branches, hours, and available stock.

guides.tip: Look for the verified badge — it confirms the pharmacy is licensed by the Ghana Pharmacy Council.

guides.title: Upload Your Prescription
guides.summary: Get a prescription-only medicine verified and ready to order in a few taps.

steps.title: Go to Upload Prescription
steps.description: Find it on the home page or your dashboard.

steps.title: Add a clear photo or scan
steps.description: Make sure all details are visible and legible.

steps.title: Choose a pharmacy
steps.description: Pick your preferred pharmacy, or let FyndRx recommend one nearby.

steps.title: Submit
steps.description: You'll get an instant confirmation that your prescription was received.

guides.tip: Make sure the prescription date, dosage, and doctor's signature are clearly visible to avoid delays.

guides.title: Track Verification & Fulfillment
guides.summary: Know exactly where your prescription is in the review process.

steps.title: Open My Prescriptions
steps.description: Find it from your dashboard.

steps.title: Check the status
steps.description: See Pending Review, Verified, or Ready for Checkout.

steps.title: Get notified
steps.description: A licensed pharmacist typically approves it within 1–3 hours.

steps.title: Complete your order
steps.description: Add the verified items to your cart and check out.

guides.tip: Verification can take longer outside business hours — plan ahead for regular medication.

guides.title: Request a Refill
guides.summary: Reorder repeat medication without digging out the original prescription.

steps.title: Open a past prescription
steps.description: Find it under "My Prescriptions".

steps.title: Tap Request Refill
steps.description: Start a new order from the same prescription.

steps.title: Confirm delivery & payment
steps.description: Review your details before submitting.

steps.title: Renew if expired
steps.description: Book a quick teleconsultation if your prescription is no longer valid.

guides.tip: Set a personal reminder a few days before you run out — refill requests still go through pharmacist review.

guides.title: Book a Teleconsultation
guides.summary: Speak to a licensed doctor from home and get medical advice fast.

steps.title: Open Telehealth
steps.description: Select "Telehealth" from the main menu.

steps.title: Describe your reason for visit
steps.description: Briefly explain your symptoms or concern.

steps.title: Choose a doctor & time
steps.description: Pick from available licensed doctors and open slots.

steps.title: Confirm and pay
steps.description: Secure your slot by paying the consultation fee.

guides.tip: Have your health profile filled in — doctors can review your history before the call for faster, safer advice.

guides.title: Attend Your Consultation
guides.summary: Join your appointment and talk to your doctor by chat or video.

steps.title: Join on time
steps.description: Open "My Consultations" a few minutes before your slot.

steps.title: Connect with your doctor
steps.description: Chat or video call from any device.

steps.title: Discuss your symptoms
steps.description: Get medical advice and next steps in real time.

guides.tip: Find a quiet, well-lit space with a stable internet connection for video consultations.

guides.title: Get Your e-Prescription
guides.summary: Receive a doctor-issued prescription instantly, with no upload needed.

steps.title: Finish your consultation
steps.description: Your doctor issues a digital prescription if one is needed.

steps.title: Find it automatically
steps.description: It appears in "My Prescriptions" right away.

steps.title: Order as usual
steps.description: Choose a pharmacy, add to cart, and check out.

guides.tip: e-Prescriptions skip manual verification since they come directly from a licensed doctor.

guides.title: Add Items to Your Cart & Checkout
guides.summary: Move from browsing to a confirmed order in a few taps.

steps.title: Add to cart
steps.description: From search results or a verified prescription.

steps.title: Review your order
steps.description: Check quantities and confirm the selected pharmacy.

steps.title: Choose delivery or pickup
steps.description: Pick home delivery or in-store pharmacy pickup at checkout.

guides.tip: Ordering multiple items from the same pharmacy saves on delivery fees.

guides.title: Pay Securely
guides.summary: Complete payment with Mobile Money, card, or bank transfer.

steps.title: Choose a payment method
steps.description: MTN Mobile Money, Vodafone Cash, AirtelTigo Money, Visa, Mastercard, or bank transfer.

steps.title: Confirm payment
steps.description: Approve the prompt on your phone or enter your card details.

steps.title: Get your receipt
steps.description: Receive an instant order confirmation and digital receipt.

guides.tip: All payments are processed through PCI-DSS compliant gateways — FyndRx never stores your card details.

guides.title: Track Your Order & Delivery
guides.summary: Follow your medication from confirmation to your doorstep.

steps.title: Open My Orders
steps.description: See real-time status for every active order.

steps.title: Follow each stage
steps.description: Confirmed, Dispensed, Out for Delivery, and Delivered.

steps.title: Stay notified
steps.description: Get SMS and push notifications at every step.

steps.title: Confirm receipt
steps.description: Mark your order received once it arrives.

guides.tip: Most same-city orders arrive within 2–4 hours; same-day delivery is available at participating pharmacies.

guides.title: Manage Favorites
guides.summary: Save medications and pharmacies you use often for instant reordering.

steps.title: Tap the heart icon
steps.description: Available on any medication or pharmacy page.

steps.title: Open Favorites anytime
steps.description: Access all your saved items from one screen.

steps.title: Reorder in seconds
steps.description: Add a favorite straight to your cart in a couple of taps.

guides.tip: Favoriting your regular medications makes monthly reordering nearly instant.

guides.title: Review Transactions & Receipts
guides.summary: Keep track of every payment and download proof for your records.

steps.title: Open Transactions
steps.description: See your full payment history in one place.

steps.title: Open a transaction
steps.description: Tap any entry to view its digital receipt.

steps.title: Save or share it
steps.description: Use receipts for insurance claims or expense records.

guides.tip: Digital receipts are also emailed to you automatically after every payment.

guides.title: Get Help Anytime
guides.summary: Reach the FyndRx support team whenever something needs attention.

steps.title: Check the Help Center
steps.description: Browse guides and answers to common questions.

steps.title: Report a specific problem
steps.description: Use "Report a Problem" for order or account issues.

steps.title: Contact support directly
steps.description: Reach us by email, phone, or in-app chat, 24/7.

guides.tip: Include your order or transaction reference when contacting support — it speeds up resolution.
